{{Short description|none}}
This is a list of all the [[ultra-prominent peak]]s (with [[topographic prominence]] greater than 1,500 metres) in the [[Himalayas]]. Listed separately, to the west and north-west are the [[List of Ultras of the Karakoram and Hindu Kush|Karakoram and Hindu Kush Ultras]], and while to the north-east and east are the [[List of Ultras of Tibet, East Asia and neighbouring areas|ultras of Tibet]]. 9 of the 10 Himalayan [[Eight-thousander|8,000m peaks]] are ultras (the exception is [[Lhotse]]), and there are a further 28 peaks over 7000m.
